name: STRANGER SYNTH
author: swtdr34mz
tagline: A performance synth: 80s analogue walls, arps, a heartbeat, tape effects
description: A performance synth in the spirit of the 80s analogue film scores: walls of detuned saws, resonant filters, arps, tape that stops and warps. 13 presets, four macros on sweetspots (SHAPE, DRIFT, SPACE, FILTER) and SIZE; a low split the melody follows; an arp on either hand that follows MIDI clock; chords from one finger; a sidechain; a heartbeat as the groove; eight performance effects (tape stop, VHS, rewind, gated reverb, echo, lights out, walkie, riser); LINK to a second FM-1 with SIX MACHINES. On the screen a small town at night and a mirror world.
credits: Based on OFFWORLD (swtdr34mz). Built on fm1-base (Charles Vestal) and felucca-bsp (Leo Kuroshita, Hügelton Instruments).
